summary: The existing out-of-order block merge test is moved within tsdb/db_test.go, and its doc comment gains a note about its origin. The test body is unchanged, and it still checks that a merged all-out-of-order block keeps its hint and that WAL-only data survives reload. It touches no production code, so a line-by-line review can be skipped.
headline: Out-of-order block merge hint test relocated with updated comment
reason: Test-only relocation of an existing test with identical assertions; it cannot affect production behavior and no assertions are removed or weakened.
